column1: # Remaining Kalay tour announcements, shop/inn food examinations, ticket refund and Karagol reflection.

column3: Fresh bread is toasting.\nThe room smells wonderful.{end_wait}
A pot of curry is\nsimmering. The spices fill\nthe room.{end_wait}
Roasted eggplant topped\nwith cheese. Someone here\nknows how to cook.{end_wait}
Cucumber and yogurt salad.\nEverything looks fresh.{end_wait}
A bowl of garlic pickles.\nThe smell reaches the\ndoorway.{end_wait}
Someone keeps the stone rim\nof this well clean. The\nwater below is clear.{end_wait}
Everyone, listen! We're\nchecking the group before\nwe move on.{end_wait}
Hold on. We're missing\nsomeone. Has anyone seen\nthe old man?{end_wait}
Colosso is close now. We\nneed to decide if we're\nentering.{end_wait}
That's enough. We can't\nwait here all day. We're\nleaving!{end_wait}
Kalay isn't perfect, but\npeople here look out for\neach other.{end_wait}
Here's the cost of your\nticket back. I can't say\nwhen a ship will sail{page_break}again.{end_wait}
The Karagol is beautiful\nfrom here.{page_break}Almost makes me forget\nall that trouble.{page_break}{text_effect:4}Sniff...{reset_text_style}{end_wait}
